NC-008.reason: Extension side: superCode.ts drops the three master codes, the public SUPER_SALT and the FNV-1a checksum. A super code is DDK2.<payload>.<Ed25519 signature> verified with WebCrypto against the public key from service_contract.json#dingdoudou.super_code_public_key, and it must name this extension's device id and an unexpired exp. The stored license is re-verified on every license.get. With no public key in the contract (currently none), every code is rejected (fail closed). The minting and server-side rejection half is laravel's (see cross_end).
